attestation.statement: I designate each person listed as a real human being, not an AI system, script or automated service, and I take responsibility for the independence each role requires. This file is a record of my designation. The checking tool cannot authenticate anyone from a string.

id_rule: a short private code, 2 to 32 characters of letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter, unique ignoring case; keep the mapping to real names outside the repository

person_entry_fields.fluent_english: true or false, never left out
person_entry_fields.independent_of_corpus_authoring: true only if the person did not write the corpus templates, this tooling or this protocol
person_entry_fields.native_turkish: true or false, never left out

roles.adjudicator: decides a row or template on which two reviewers differ; never one of them
roles.author: writes held-out evaluation tasks; native Turkish; has not seen the training data
roles.checker: checks a held-out task and its gold; never the author of that task
roles.owner: records rights decisions; the project owner
roles.reviewer: first or second reviewer of templates and rows; judges gold and naturalness

status: TEMPLATE: empty. Only the owner designates people. An AI cannot be listed as human.
